houses_and_lords.heading: The Twelve Doors — Houses & Their Lords
paragraphs: Every house in the chart is run by the planet that rules the sign on its cusp. When a house is empty of planets, that does NOT mean it has no story; it means the story is happening wherever the cusp-lord lives. This section walks all twelve houses in turn, naming each cusp-lord and where it actually sits — so the affairs of every house become readable, not just the ones with bodies parked in them.

1st house — self, body, and the way you meet the world. The sign on the cusp is Virgo; its lord is Mercury ☿, and it sits in your chart at Aries 7.67° · 8th house. Mercury is peregrine — without strong essential dignity, shaped most by house and aspect rather than by the sign. It is placed in the middle distance, building and sustaining. Therefore the affairs of your 1st house are run through your 8th house of depth and shared resource — what feels like your self actually plays out wherever Mercury lives, not where the empty cusp sits. Watch depth and shared resource to see this house move.

2nd house — money, resources, and what you call valuable. The sign on the cusp is Libra; its lord is Venus ♀, and it sits in your chart at Aries 26.43° · 8th house. Venus is in detriment — improvising tools that don't come standard, building hard-won competence. It is placed in the middle distance, building and sustaining. Therefore the affairs of your 2nd house are run through your 8th house of depth and shared resource — what feels like your money actually plays out wherever Venus lives, not where the empty cusp sits. Watch depth and shared resource to see this house move.

3rd house — daily mind, voice, siblings, and near travel. The sign on the cusp is Scorpio; its lord is Mars ♂, and it sits in your chart at Gemini 20.73° · 10th house. Mars is peregrine — without strong essential dignity, shaped most by house and aspect rather than by the sign. It is placed on the chart's load-bearing wall, loud and early. Therefore the affairs of your 3rd house are run through your 10th house of vocation — what feels like your daily mind actually plays out wherever Mars lives, not where the empty cusp sits. Watch vocation to see this house move.

4th house — home, roots, ancestry, and the inner foundation. The sign on the cusp is Sagittarius; its lord is Jupiter ♃, and it sits in your chart at Leo 3.88° · 12th house · retrograde. Jupiter is peregrine — without strong essential dignity, shaped most by house and aspect rather than by the sign; retrograde — turned inward, asking to be integrated before it can be expressed outward. It is placed behind the scenes, working through learning and adjustment. Therefore the affairs of your 4th house are run through your 12th house of the unseen — what feels like your home actually plays out wherever Jupiter lives, not where the empty cusp sits. Watch the unseen to see this house move.

5th house — creative play, romance, children, and what you make. The sign on the cusp is Capricorn; its lord is Saturn ♄, and it sits in your chart at Aquarius 3.87° · 6th house. Saturn is at home, working on its own terms, with full access to its tools. It is placed behind the scenes, working through learning and adjustment. Therefore the affairs of your 5th house are run through your 6th house of work and health — what feels like your creative play actually plays out wherever Saturn lives, not where the empty cusp sits. Held together, the twelve doors tell you which areas of your life move through which engines. Where a lord is angular and dignified, that house flows; where it is in detriment, retrograde, or cadent, the house asks for conscious work to come alive. When in doubt about an area of life, find its lord, see where it lives, and read the affairs of the house through the affairs of the lord's house.

frame_reminder: Read every house through active Pinnacle 8 (2026-2034, material mastery) and Personal Year 1 (founding). Do not frame money as permanently hard under the 8 Pinnacle.
